svg.title: PayPal SEC RAG pipeline architecture
svg.desc: SEC ingestion, fixed and semantic chunking, MPNet embeddings, Pinecone storage, three retrieval experiments, Nebius generation, and RAGAS evaluation. A separate callout describes the interactive chain.
svg.text: Implementation architecture • paypal_sec_10k.ipynb • Current local reports: FY 2023–2025
Source path, SEC URL, report / filing date
Strip tags, decode entities, tidy whitespace
Stable SHA-256 IDs for repeatable uploads
Secondary split: at most 8,000 characters, no overlap
Keep parent / piece offsets · stable SHA-256 IDs
Shared local embedding model · normalized 768-dimensional vectors
Used for semantic boundaries, document embeddings, and question embeddings
Cosine index · vectors + chunk text + source metadata
Replace fixed namespace; upload batches of 100
Same index and filings · independent chunk collection
Replace semantic namespace; upload batches of 100
Missing index: create serverless on AWS us-east-1. Existing index: validate 768 dimensions and cosine metric.
Question → same MPNet model → cosine similarity search
10 evaluation questions · no date filter in experiments · semantic candidate pool shared by B and C
Keep first 3 in cosine retrieval order
05 / GENERATE A CITED ANSWER FOR EACH EXPERIMENT
Same prompt across A, B and C
Ground truth used only for evaluation
Paired changes: B − A and C − B
Results: data/experiments/<run>/results_*.json, traces.json, errors.json → ragas_<run>/ score and analysis files
Ground truth is attached after generation. The small development set and model judgments do not establish a winning strategy.
Notebook question → semantic retrieval (20 candidates) → optional Qwen reranking → top 3 → Nebius answer
LangChain RunnableLambda: retrieve_rag_context | generate_rag_answer; use_reranker defaults to False.
Optional metadata_filter (for example, report_date). The example and four-question end-to-end check enable reranking.
Inspect passages, source dates and citation IDs in the notebook; end-to-end results saved to data/rag_e2e_results.json.
scripts/run_rag_experiments.py runs the three-experiment collector against existing namespaces; it does not write the index.
Cleanup is basic; hidden inline XBRL may remain. Long semantic pieces may exceed MPNet's input token limit.
The diagram documents implemented flow and defaults; citation checks validate structure, while factual accuracy needs review.
STACK LangChain / MPNet / Pinecone / Nebius / Qwen / GPT-OSS / RAGAS
Source: paypal_sec_10k.ipynb + scripts/run_rag_experiments.py • Architecture snapshot: 18 October 2026
